inclusions.text: Guide, driver, and transfers to and from the airport at both ends
inclusions.source: What the tour covers is everything on the Cairo side — guide, driver, and transfers to and from the airport at both ends.

inclusions.text: Admission to the Giza Plateau and the Grand Egyptian Museum (Base + Entrance Fees and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch tiers only)
inclusions.source: The tour comes in three tiers, so you only pay for what you want: a Base package (private transfers, Egyptologist guide, water, and all logistics on the Cairo side); Base + Entrance Fees (the same, plus admission to the Giza Plateau and the Grand Egyptian Museum); and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch (those entrance fees plus a midday meal).
